definitions.gloss: bile; digestive fluid produced by the liver
definitions.explanation: A yellow-green digestive fluid produced by the liver, stored in the gallbladder, and released into the small intestine to aid in fat digestion.

examples.japanese: {胆汁|たんじゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{脂肪|しぼう}→脂肪：03199_shibou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{消化|しょうか}→消化：04200_shouka⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{助|たす}ける→助ける：00895_tasukeru⟧。
examples.english: Bile aids in the digestion of fats.

examples.japanese: ⟦{胆嚢|たんのう}→胆嚢：29067_tannou⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{胆汁|たんじゅう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{蓄|たくわ}える→蓄える：08996_takuwaeru⟧⟦{臓器|ぞうき}→臓器：05705_zouki⟧だ。
examples.english: The gallbladder is the organ that stores bile.

examples.japanese: ⟦{肝臓|かんぞう}→肝臓：05029_kanzou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{生成|せいせい}→生成：10895_seisei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧{胆汁|たんじゅう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{胆嚢|たんのう}→胆嚢：29067_tannou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{蓄|たくわ}えられ→蓄える：08996_takuwaeru⟧、⟦{食事|しょくじ}→食事：02087_shokuji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{際|さい}→際：02819_sai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{小腸|しょうちょう}⟦へ→へ：02473_he⟧⟦{放出|ほうしゅつ}→放出：12926_houshutsu⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Bile produced in the liver is stored in the gallbladder and released into the small intestine during meals.

notes:
{胆|たん} refers to the gallbladder; {汁|じゅう} means juice or liquid. A standard medical and anatomical term.
